import os, socket, threading
SRC, DST = "/run/bench74592511-proxy.sock", "/run/containerd/containerd.sock"
def pipe(a, b):
    try:
        while True:
            d = a.recv(65536)
            if not d: break
            b.sendall(d)
    except OSError: pass
    for s in (a, b):
        try: s.shutdown(socket.SHUT_RDWR)
        except OSError: pass
if os.path.exists(SRC): os.unlink(SRC)
srv = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX); srv.bind(SRC); os.chmod(SRC, 0o666); srv.listen(16)
while True:
    c, _ = srv.accept()
    u = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX); u.connect(DST)
    threading.Thread(target=pipe, args=(c, u), daemon=True).start()
    threading.Thread(target=pipe, args=(u, c), daemon=True).start()
